title: 第23章 我师姐护短第24章 点香燃烛叩像拜鬼神
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
嗤嗤嗤——
空气冒腾着灼灼热气。
陈俊煌身上被鬼神之力冲击囊鼓的差服袂角，慢慢垂落，他微微吐出一口气，手中精锻差刀一卷，于铿锵声间归鞘。
随后，面色凝重的看向了倪嫣，微微躬身抱拳。
“倪嫣姑娘，本官非是有意，只是例行查案而已。”
“例行查案？用‘惑神术’这等鬼神秘术，你管这叫例行查案？！”
“若是伤了我浪师弟的精神，影响到他那让叶大师都为之惊叹的雕工天赋，你区区一个云霄外城巡捕头赔偿的起吗？！”
倪嫣双眸仍旧在流淌火光，红裙裙摆飘卷，气势节节攀升！
面纱摆动，纱下红唇轻启。
如舌绽冬雷！
展现出姿态，就五个字。
我，师姐，护短！
这女娃子是上嘴脸了啊！
陈俊煌深吸一口气，面色微微变化，倪嫣此女来历不俗，更是被天工坊六锁大师裴琉璃收为弟子，绝非他惹得起的。
云霄外城的官府捕头，或许在外城位高权重，但在内城的大人物眼中，却是算不得什么，哪怕……他是鬼神修士，也一样。
这倪嫣不过十五岁而已，就已经凝纹三道，且每一道鬼神纹质量极高！
显然所修炼的鬼神功法品秩极高，远非他所修炼的朝廷传授的鬼神官修功法能比的，再加上“鬼神币”
管够，资源尽情堆彻！
他陈俊煌虽然是凝纹四道，且兼修武道炼气化精，论及战斗力，却也未必比得上此女！
炽热如浪，倪嫣青丝飞扬，双眸染上赤红，赤红色的鬼神之力像是北地极光一般，迷蒙晕染，如梦似幻！

整个练武场的空气，都笼罩在一层压抑之中。
气氛沉凝至极，让人无法喘息！
“倪嫣姑娘说笑了，在下真的只是例行查案而已……”
“三掌柜报案到官府，本官查案，乃是本职工作，至于动用鬼神秘术……着实是因为此案棘手，本官不得不多动用一些手段，搜寻任何有用的线索。”
陈俊煌面色难看，抱拳再多躬几分身躯，说道。
姿态放的很低。
倪嫣倒也不再继续打出杀伐，但是鬼神之力并未收敛。
三道鬼神纹狂舞，迈步而行，地面的积雪都宛如在她行进间，融化成水，继而化作颗粒分明的水珠，反重力般漂浮而起，犹如神女出行，气魄无双！
“哼！
我浪师弟为了保护被圣童教盯上的妹妹，发疯的勤奋提升雕刻技艺，不知道熬了多少个夜晚，呕心沥血多少时日，才终于打破歹人的阴谋成正式雕师。”
“他不曾觉醒鬼神纹，属于平平无奇的凡俗一位！”
“昨日才刚向叶大师求得武道之路，哪里有什么本事杀的了唐宇？如此老实本分的一个人，也值得怀疑？！”
倪嫣声音清冷，充满铿锵与愤懑。
因为李浪这老实师弟被欺负而愤慨不休！
“老实人，就活该被你们欺负吗？！”
最后一句话，如滚滚冬雷炸响环绕在练武场，整个练武场，鸦雀无声！
陈俊煌哑口无言，跟随他而来的两位官差也羞愧的别过脑袋。
污蔑一个不修鬼神纹，刚练武一日的凡人，杀死一位半步凝纹的鬼神修士……
这不就是赤果果的欺负老实人么？
唐老三面色难看至极，面容上却也不由闪烁，心生迟疑。

的确……李浪根本没本事杀死唐宇啊。
content_en:
Chi chi chi——
The air was steaming with heat.
The sleeves of Chen Junhuang's official uniform, which had been bulged by the force of ghosts and gods, slowly fell down. He exhaled slightly, and a finely forged sword in his hand was sheathed with a clang.
Then, he looked at Ni Yan with a solemn expression, bowed slightly and clasped his fists.
"Miss Ni Yan, I didn't do this intentionally, it was just a routine investigation."
"Routine investigation? Using ghost and mysterious techniques such as 'confusion of gods', you call this a routine investigation?!"
"If it hurts my junior brother Lang's spirit and affects his carving talent that even Master Ye is amazed by, can you, a mere patrol leader in Yunxiao Outer City, afford the compensation?!"
Ni Yan's eyes are still shining with fire, her red skirt is fluttering, and her momentum is rising!
The veil swings, and the red lips part under the veil.
Like tongue bursting with winter thunder!
Show your attitude, just five words.
I, senior sister, will protect you!
This little girl is really talking about her face!
Chen Junhuang took a deep breath and his expression changed slightly. Ni Yan had a good background and was accepted as a disciple by Pei Liuli, the master of the Six Locks of Tiangongfang. He was definitely not something he could afford to offend.
The official arrester in the outer city of Yunxiao may have a high position in the outer city, but in the eyes of the big shots in the inner city, he is nothing, even if... he is a ghost monk.
This Ni Yan is only fifteen years old, but she already has three condensation patterns, and each ghost pattern is of extremely high quality!
Obviously, the ghost and god skills he practiced were of extremely high quality, far beyond the level of the ghost and god official skills he practiced taught by the imperial court. In addition, the "ghost and god coins"
If you have enough control, the resources will be piled up as much as you can!
Although he, Chen Junhuang, possesses the four levels of condensation patterns and also practices martial arts, refining qi and transforming essence, he may not be as good as this woman when it comes to combat prowess!
It was as hot as waves, Ni Yan's black hair was flying, her eyes were dyed red, and the red ghost power was like the northern aurora, hazy and dreamlike!
The air in the entire martial arts training ground was enveloped in a layer of depression.
The atmosphere was so tense that it was hard to breathe!
"Miss Ni Yan is joking, I'm really just doing a routine investigation..."
"The third shopkeeper reported the case to the government. It is my duty to investigate the case. As for using ghost and mystical techniques... it is actually because the case is difficult, so I have to use more methods to search for any useful clues."
Chen Junhuang looked ugly, clasped his fists and bowed a little more, and said.
The posture is very low.
Ni Yan no longer continued to kill, but the power of ghosts and gods did not restrain.
Three ghost and god patterns danced wildly as she walked, and the snow on the ground seemed to melt into water as she walked, and then turned into clear-grained water droplets, floating up against gravity, like a goddess traveling, with unparalleled courage!
"Hmph!
In order to protect my younger sister who was targeted by the Holy Child Cult, my junior brother Lang worked frantically to improve his carving skills. I didn’t know how many nights I spent and how many days of hard work I finally broke through the villain’s conspiracy and became an official carver. "
"He has never awakened the ghost and god patterns, he is an ordinary mortal!"
"I just asked Master Ye for the path to martial arts yesterday. How could I kill Tang Yu? Such an honest and responsible person is worthy of doubt?!"
Ni Yan's voice was cold, full of sonority and anger.
Because Li Lang, an honest junior fellow student, was being bullied and was indignant!
"An honest man, do you deserve to be bullied by you?!"
The last words, like rolling winter thunder, surrounded the martial arts training ground, and the entire martial arts training ground was silent!
Chen Junhuang was speechless, and the two officials who followed him turned their heads away in shame.
Slandering a mortal who has just practiced martial arts for one day without cultivating ghost and god patterns, and killing a ghost and god monk who has half-stepped the condensation patterns...
Isn't this just Chi Guoguo bullying honest people?
Tang Laosan looked extremely ugly, but his face could not help but flicker and hesitate.
Indeed... Li Lang has no ability to kill Tang Yu.
